name: compact-lens
description: See every compaction of a session and what its summary dropped, give your prompts or any lost detail back to Claude, pin facts that must survive, and edit the summary.

warnAtPercent.title: Warn at
warnAtPercent.description: How close to auto-compaction, as a percent of the way there, the model gets one note ahead of the compaction (measured to the window when auto-compaction is off). 0 turns the note off.

dir.title: Snapshot folder
dir.description: Where the snapshots go. Empty means ~/.claude/compact-lens.

openPane.title: Open the pane at start
openPane.description: Open the Compact Lens pane when a session starts. A wide terminal seats it; a narrow one keeps it waiting.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Keep a line under the prompt with the context against auto-compaction, the compactions so far and the pinned notes.
